Body.Content: Microsoft Discovery is now generally available, providing research and development organizations an enterprise platform for building and governing agentic AI workflows across scientific and engineering disciplines. Also available in preview is the Microsoft Discovery app, a local desktop experience that helps researchers and scientific teams begin working with agentic discovery today without requiring cloud infrastructure.
Body.Markdown:
Microsoft Discovery is now generally available, providing research and development organizations an enterprise

platform for building and governing agentic AI workflows across scientific and

engineering disciplines. Also available in preview is the Microsoft Discovery app, a local desktop experience that helps researchers and scientific teams begin working with agentic discovery today without requiring cloud infrastructure.
